about: Scenarios (docs/ENGINEERING_SYSTEM.md section 3.2). State is derived from the proof each names; a scenario is never itself proof. PROTOCOL-class: changing this file needs an approval record.

scenarios.name: Closing is not an effect
given: any closing observation with a matching open loop
then: the effect is CLOSURE_CANDIDATE, never a close
mustNot: a loop that is closed by an observation

proof.check: closing is not an effect: no CLOSE, only CLOSURE_CANDIDATE
four effects, and closing is not one of them
every closing type needs a match, and none matched is nothing

scenarios.name: A payment before its bill closes nothing
given: a payment dated before the bill of the same amount
mustNot: a candidate from a payment that came first

proof.check: a payment before the bill closes nothing [0]
a payment before the bill closes no obligation

scenarios.name: The matching window is 45 days
given: a bill and a payment of the same amount from the same source
when: they are 45 and then 46 days apart

proof.check: exactly 45 days is [0]
too late (46 days) is not the same obligation [0]
reminders 45 days apart are one obligation, 46 are two

scenarios.name: One bill is closed by one payment
given: one bill and two payments of its amount
mustNot: both payments matched to one bill

proof.check: one bill is closed by one payment, not two [0]

scenarios.name: Money in does not close a bill I owe
given: a bill I owe and money coming in of the same amount
mustNot: a credit closing a debt of mine

proof.check: money coming in does not close a bill I owe [0]

scenarios.name: A different amount or a different source is not the same obligation
given: a bill and a payment differing in amount, or in source

proof.check: a different amount is not the same obligation [0]
a different source is not the same obligation [0]

scenarios.name: A payment that states its own fulfilment is one payment
given: one message saying both that money moved and that a card bill was paid
then: one closing; the money beside it belongs to it
mustNot: a double count of the same payment

proof.check: a payment that states its own fulfilment is one payment, and its fulfilment is the closer [0]
a payment and its own fulfilment are one closing: the fulfilment is the closer, and the money moved beside it belongs to it

scenarios.name: Correlation does not depend on order
given: a set of openings and closings
when: every rotation and the reverse are correlated
mustNot: a result that depends on arrival order

proof.check: every rotation and the reverse give the same obligations and the same matches
the closings are taken in the order they happened, whatever order they arrive in: both are matched

scenarios.name: A sealed bundle altered afterwards is not believed
given: a bundle with a line edited after sealing
then: the altered line no longer matches its id and is dropped
mustNot: a field that forges another line

proof.check: a line altered after it was sealed no longer matches its own id and is not believed
a tab, a line break or a backslash in a field cannot split or forge a line

scenarios.name: Retention is a 24-month policy
then: the oldest ages out, then the next
mustNot: retention assumed by the data model

proof.check: retention is a policy: 24 months
a later month ages the oldest bundle out (September 2026 is 25 months before October 2028)
a month outside the window is not kept
